summary: The requested iteration value is propagated from CLI into spmvGpu; CSR construction closes the final row at n=floor(dim²/sparsity). The closure selects one of row-width kernels 1/2/4/8/16/32 by average nnz, or spmvLongRows at average>=256. Row kernels launch enough blocks for all rows and accumulate each [rows[row],rows[row+1]) interval in ThreadsPerRow strides before storing; the long kernel caps blocks at 65535 but has a row grid-stride loop, and each block processes its selected row's full CSR interval in 128 strides then reduces/stores. Warmup and graph construction occur before timing. The host graph contains batch=min(iterations,64) launch calls; the timed graph loop runs iterations/batch times and the direct tail runs iterations%batch. Compiled host preserves the exact capture loop, graph loop, remainder, CUDA closure dispatch and event stop/sync. Inspected all seven native sm86 variants through their nonzero-loop/backedge, reduction and output store. No omission identified.
